code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    n = max(v for row in grid for v in row)
    phase = max(
        range(1, n + 1),
        key=lambda p: sum(
            1 for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row)
            if value and r != 0 and r != c and value == (p - 1 + c) % n + 1
        ),
    )
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = (phase - 1 + c) % n + 1
    return out
'''
